name: CHICHA San Chen - Tampines One
description:
MUST TRIES: Come and try their Fresh Milk with Brown Sugar Bubble, Cassia Black Tea with Mousse, Honey Osmanthus Oolong Tea, and a lot more. CHICHA San Chen is a humble food stall that offers an awesome experience with their menu featuring a variety of freshly brewed teas. Every cup is freshly brewed with an exclusively patented Teapresso machine to bring out the tea's best flavour. Located at Tampines 1 along Tampines Central 1 (nearest train: Tampines MRT Station), CHICHA San Chen is the ideal place to have delectable bubble tea to satisfy your cravings. 
Source: hungrygowhere.com
